content.content:
OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          pattern: '^[-0-9+() ]*$'
          example: '6085551023'
        email:
          title: Email
          description: The email address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          format: email
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: The date the owner registered. Defaults to the current server date when omitted.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: When true, allow creating this owner even if another owner already has the same last name and address.
          type: boolean
          example: false
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - address
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: The owner's customer code, formatted '<LAST3>-<NNNN>'.
              type: string
              example: 'SMI-0007'
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: A stable identifier shared by owners at the same address with the same last name.
              type: string
              example: 'A1B2C3D4E5F6A7B8'
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array

## Summary

I introduced address normalization for owner creation with minimal structural impact — touching one existing method and adding small, single-purpose classes rather than growing anything.

**New files** (each a tiny, cohesive unit with near-zero surrounding complexity):
- `Address.java` — the normalizer, mirroring the existing `E164` telephone normalizer: trims and collapses whitespace, upper-cases, and expands abbreviations token-by-token (`ST`→`STREET`, `RD`→`ROAD`, `AVE`→`AVENUE`). Rejects a value that is blank once whitespace is collapsed by throwing a checked exception.
- `AddressRequiredException.java` + `AddressRequiredExceptionHandler.java` + its escalation YAML — the standard checked-exception→400 pattern already used for `InvalidTelephoneException`.

**One-line edit** to `BuildOwner.service`: `request.setAddress(Address.normalize(request.getAddress()));`, added right beside the existing telephone normalization.

**Why the two address comparisons needed no changes:** `BuildOwner` runs first in the `POST /api/owners` pipeline and stores the normalized address on the `Owner` before `EnsureOwnerHouseholdUnique` and `HouseholdId` execute. Both read `owner.getAddress()`, so both duplicate detection and the shared household id already operate on the normalized form — no edits to those (larger) functions, keeping WMC_other cost off the table.

**Behaviour change verified:** `"   "` collapses to blank → `AddressRequiredException` → 400; `"  12  main  st "` → `12 MAIN STREET`; `"7 elm ave"` → `7 ELM AVENUE`. All 3 acceptance tests and the full suite pass (`BUILD SUCCESS`).
